title: Course Schedule
statement: Given numCourses course IDs from 0 through numCourses - 1 and prerequisite pairs [course, prerequisite], return true if every course can be completed. Each pair means prerequisite must be completed before course.
constraints: Every course ID in prerequisites is between 0 and numCourses - 1.

examples.explanation: Course 0 can be completed before course 1.
The two courses form a directed cycle.

cpp.starter_code: class Solution { public: bool canFinish(int numCourses, vector<vector<int>> prerequisites) { return false; } };

python.display_signature: def canFinish(self, numCourses: int, prerequisites: list[list[int]]) -> bool
